compound_projection_by_level.assortativity_note: Every edge joins two members of one clique, so both ends have degree n_c - 1: Pearson degree assortativity is exactly 1 whenever at least two clique sizes occur.
compound_projection_by_level.padding_note: At the subclass level, rows whose direct parent is at depth 3 repeat the class id in the subclass slot (repeat-padding, how_this_was_built B.2); they are kept as their own clique keyed by that id (padded_rows). Null slots (119,795 rows at subclass) are isolated.
